# BEACON40

> > BEACON40® delivers clinically-researched 40Hz gamma light therapy to enhance memory, focus, and sleep while supporting brain health through light and nootropic supplements.

BEACON40 is a brain health company specializing in 40Hz light therapy devices and cognitive supplements. The site combines neuroscience research from MIT and Boston University with practical biohacking approaches to cognitive enhancement, targeting memory improvement, better sleep, and sustained focus through gamma sensory stimulation.
